Name: Dr. Rei - Custom NPC
Author: TamKungZ
Description:
[b][size=4]About this mod[/size][/b]
[size=3]Rei is a trainee doctor NPC living in Pelican Town, spending most of her time around the clinic and hospital. Her daily routine reflects her medical work, with different schedules for weekdays, weekends, and special days.[/size]
[size=3]
She features conditional dialogue that reacts to time, seasons, location, and friendship level. While her personality is generally practical and straightforward, she gradually opens up as you build a closer relationship with her.[/size]
[size=3]
Rei fully supports friendship progression and dating. Her dialogue and behavior are designed to feel natural within the Stardew Valley world, without relying on large scripted events or heavy storylines.[/size]
[size=3]
This mod focuses on providing a stable, immersive NPC experience that blends into normal gameplay, making Rei feel like a natural part of the town rather than a standalone story character.[/size]

[b][size=4]Prototype Notice[/size][/b]
[color=orange][size=3]
This mod is a work-in-progress prototype and is not yet complete.
Marriage is currently unavailable, as related content and artwork have not been created yet.
Features, dialogue, and behavior may change in future updates.
[/size][/color]

[/list]
